key_idea: N and Q are only 2000, so every query can test every observation; the work is parsing 64-bit decimal/hex values and pairing Start/End events.
sketch: Parse events with strtoull (ids and timestamps need unsigned 64-bit, addresses are hex), map id to its observation and fill in the end time on the End event. An observation occupies times [t1,t2] and addresses [x, x+L-1], all inclusive. Sort observations by id, then for each query count the rectangles that intersect the closed viewport and print the first 20 ids. O(NQ). Pitfalls: the address interval ends at x+L-1 (sample 5 shows x+L is excluded), ids must be compared as unsigned, and the count printed is the full count even when only 20 ids follow.
